title: More companies created in 2020
description: In 2020 there were 8.2% more companies created than in 2019. More interesting information in this infographic from Inform Direct.
author: Barry Adams
html: It wasn't all doom and gloom in 2020 and today we'd like to share this infographic from Inform Direct with you, which shows that in 2020 8.2% more companies were formed than in 2019.
